title: Mori Lamp
short: A task light that turns a work surface into a calmer place.
intro: A small desk lamp exploring light direction, touch feedback and repairable construction.
hero: A folded shade, a weighted base and a quiet gesture for control.

sections.title: The desk changes; the light should adapt.
sections.body: Instead of adding another smart surface, Mori focuses on the relationship between hand, shade and task. The core question was how little interaction is enough.

sections.title: The hinge is the interface.
sections.body: A visible, serviceable hinge creates a clear physical affordance. Its exposed construction also makes repair and replacement part of the product language.

sections.title: Warm where you touch it, quiet where you look.
sections.body: The material study pairs a powder-coated shell with a dense recycled base. The contrast is tactile first and visual second.
